title: `co_await` / `co_yield` / `co_return`
summary: `co_yield` navigates to its promise method, while other coroutine keywords do not
prose:
Go-to-definition on `co_yield` reaches the promise's `yield_value`. The
`co_await` and `co_return` keywords do not yet reach the awaiter's or
promise's methods.

value.wrong: should reach the awaiter's methods the expression calls
should reach the promise's return_value, which co_return calls
